explanation: Matches Telgarsky, arXiv 0911.2077, Conjecture 6.3: for p in (0,1/2) and even m, P[B(p,m) >= m/2] >= 1 - Φ((1/2-p)√m/σ) + (1/2) C(m,m/2) σ^m. With m = 2k and σ = sqrt(p(1-p)), the Lean inequality is the same, and {k,...,2k} in `Fin (2k+1)` is the event B >= m/2 (the casts of k and 2k do not wrap, since both are below 2k+1). The hypothesis k > 0 drops only the trivial m = 0 case, where both sides equal 1. Faithful.
